items.html: Know that all these ten Sefirot are in the place of the head of Arich Anpin, and not below. And the aspect of the Yesod of this brain is the palate (cheich) within the mouth of Arich Anpin, and the aspect of the Malchut of this brain is in the throat of Arich Anpin. However, relative to the aspect of the whole Partzuf of Arich Anpin, it is called his Bina, as above; but it is only the aspect of Malchut relative to this brain.
